subject: Changing the symbol in the legend key in 0.9.2

messages.author: 066b54eefceeb668
messages.subject: Changing the symbol in the legend key in 0.9.2
parts:
When using an aesthetic in geom_text, the symbol that appears in the legend key is a lower case "a". Some time ago, I asked on Stack Exchange if it was possible to change the symbol to, say, an upper case "N".  Kohske Takahashi provided the answer. The following code worked using version 0.9.1. The legend symbol was an upper case "N".

      library(ggplot2)
      library(grid)
      df <- expand.grid(x = factor(seq(1:5)), y = factor(seq(1:5)))
      df$Count = seq(1:25)

      ggplot(data = df, aes( x = x, y = y, label = Count, size = Count)) +
          geom_text() +
          scale_size(range = c(2, 10))

      grid.gedit("^key-[-0-9]+$", label = "N")

However, using version 0.9.2, the last line generates an error:
      Error in editDLfromGPath(gPath, specs, strict, grep, global, redraw) :  'gPath' (^key-[-0-9]+$) not found 
and the symbol remains a lower case "a".

Is there a way to change the symbol in the legend key in version 0.9.2?
